Write a DICOM Volume to NIfTI-1 With dcm2niix-Compatible Geometry

Source: R/nifti.R
write_nifti.Rd

Exports a dicom_volume, "dicom_series", or DICOM path to a NIfTI-1 file (.nii or .nii.gz) whose voxel layout and world-space orientation match dcm2niix: voxel (i, j, k) is (column, flipped row, slice) and both an exact RAS sform (preserving any gantry-tilt shear) and an orthogonalized quaternion qform (via the NIfTI-1 nifti_mat44_to_quatern algorithm) are written with codes 1.

Usage

write_nifti(
  x,
  out_path = NULL,
  json_sidecar = TRUE,
  backend = c("auto", "rnifti", "builtin")
)

Arguments

x

A dicom_volume, a "dicom_series" object, or a path to a DICOM file, directory, or vector of files.

out_path

Output .nii / .nii.gz path. Defaults to a temporary .nii file. ".nii" is appended when the path has neither extension.

json_sidecar

Logical. When TRUE (default) writes a BIDS-style <stem>.json sidecar (Modality, ImageOrientationPatientDICOM, SliceThickness (nominal DICOM value), SpacingBetweenSlices, RepetitionTime, EchoTime, PixelSpacing, ConversionSoftware, ...) next to the image.

backend

Writer backend: "auto" (default; RNifti when installed, otherwise the built-in dependency-free writer), "rnifti", or "builtin".

Value

Invisibly returns out_path.

Examples

out_dir <- tempfile("nifti_demo_")
dicom_synthesize(out_dir = out_dir, modality = "CT", dims = c(16L, 16L, 4L))
vol <- read_dicom_volume(out_dir)
nii <- write_nifti(vol, tempfile(fileext = ".nii"), backend = "builtin")
file.exists(nii)
#> [1] TRUE
unlink(c(out_dir, nii, sub("\\.nii$", ".json", nii)), recursive = TRUE)
